text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #24354b

g.text: PrismQuant aligns activation geometry with the affine degrees of freedom of grouped asymmetric INT4. The fork starts from the

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #24354b

g.text: same raw activations (a): Hadamard spreads energy (b), whereas PrismQuant aligns dominant eigendirections with

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #24354b

g.text: quantizer-induced group-constant directions. Panels c and d are matched outcomes of these two rotations, not sequential

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #24354b

g.text: transformations: they show the within-group max-minus-min ranges that determine quantizer scale, using identical token/group

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #24354b

g.text: coordinates, camera, and 0–10 height/color normalization. Both branches use the same grouped asymmetric INT4 quantizer (group

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #24354b

g.text: size 128). Panels c/d use one shared height colormap. The matrix, alignment, and quantizer glyphs are unscaled conceptual

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #24354b

g.text: annotations, not additional measurements. The quantizer's affine offset represents a common group shift; subtracting an offset by

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #24354b

g.text: itself does not change max-minus-min range.

g.text: The lower evidence strip retains the three measured signed activation traces: raw (e), Hadamard (f), and PrismQuant (g). Their

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #24354b

g.text: range brackets are 11.656, 1.708, and 0.763, respectively, on a common signed-value scale. The dashed green line in g is the actual

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #24354b

g.text: affine INT4 offset fp16(min x), not the group mean. These are trace measurements, not quantization-error or captured-energy plots.
